metadata.selection: Fixed illustrative penalties; no parameter selected on test outcomes.
metadata.pairing: Methods use identical data/splits within each repetition; scenarios reuse RNG seeds.
metadata.uncertainty: q1/q3 describe dataset variability; mc_se_mean is a descriptive Monte Carlo SE, not a confidence interval. Heavy tails may make 40 repeats insufficient.
metadata.axis_order: summaries: degree then method; raw test MSE: repetition, degree, method
metadata.noise_free_caveat: sigma=0 measures approximation/generalization without irreducible noise.
